title: Lufthansa Cargo 8533
summary: Boeing 727-200 freighter VT-LCI departed Kathmandu on July 7, 1999 at 19:51 local time. After turning to heading 247 at 4.4 DME during climb, power was inadvertently reduced causing aircraft to descend to 7,500 feet in an area requiring 9,500 feet minimum altitude. GPWS activated as aircraft impacted Champadevi Hills at 2,200 meters, killing all five crew.
probable_cause: Power inadvertently reduced during initial climb, resulting in aircraft descending to 7,500 feet in an area where minimum departure altitude of 9,500 feet must be maintained, leading to terrain impact

events.text: Boeing 727-200 Freighter VT-LCI departs runway 20 at Kathmandu Tribhuvan International Airport
Aircraft makes 10-degree bank to heading 247 at 4.4 DME
Power applied on engines is inadvertently reduced during climb
Aircraft loses height and descends to 7,500 feet in area requiring 9,500 feet minimum altitude
Ground Proximity Warning System activates with terrain warning and stick shaker
Aircraft impacts Champadevi Hills at 2,200 meters altitude; all five crew perish
